name: standing-palms-in-dumbbell-press.html
instructions:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells with a neutral grip and assume a shoulder-width stance.
2. Raise the dumbbells to around shoulder height while maintaining a neutral grip. This is the starting position.
3. Slowly press the dumbbells overhead by extending the elbows and contracting the deltoids.
4. Once your arms are fully extended, begin lowering the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat this movement for the desired amount of reps.
